risk_summary: The disclosure presents significant financial and operational risk, including an accumulated deficit of $116.4 million, continuing losses, dependence on future financing, and suspension of the ICT-107 phase 3 trial after insufficient funding. Quantified historical expenses and cash usage improve transparency, but optimistic descriptions of unproven technologies and repeated forward-looking disclaimers introduce uncertainty.
